condition: The participating adult's effective pathway assigns Simplified Issue questions
purpose: Shared SI questionnaire and applicable follow-up detail records.

condition: The effective product/applicant policy assigns full health questions, Critical Illness questions, or their configured combination
purpose: Shared TELE page with the assigned questionnaire; CI is a product-dependent variation within TELE.

condition: The effective product/applicant pathway assigns externally hosted QuickDecision health questions
purpose: Configured prototype image handoff, followed by standard saving and navigation. No live underwriting service or external questionnaire executes.

condition: The effective product/applicant combination requires supplemental Disability questions
purpose: Shared supplemental Disability questionnaire and follow-up detail records.

condition: The participating adult selects the rider and its effective assignment requires CIR questions
purpose: Assigned Chronic Illness Rider questionnaire on its shared page.
